bio: The Delftse Schie provides a striking focal point in this elegant restaurant – the view is nothing short of breathtaking. A meal on the waterfront terrace is an experience not to be missed. You have a choice of two French-inspired set menus with bursts of Mediterranean flair. Familiar flavours are subtly elevated by creams and other accompaniments. For instance, the chef pairs medium-rare veal fillet with asparagus and lemon mayonnaise, wild asparagus with dill, pommes Anna and a syrupy veal jus. The elegantly plated dishes reflect the restaurant's ambition. Thanks to Indy and Justin, this renowned establishment has been given a new lease of life....
